violation_type.title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over (26 TAC §746.3701(10))
violation_type.short_title: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over
violation_type.typical_finding: The TV in the stage area was not anchored. Photos were taken.

finding_variants.text: The TV in the stage area was not anchored. Photos were taken.
Two televisions were observed to be not anchored.

occurrences.finding: Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: Two televisions were observed to be unmounted with the electrical cords accessible to children.  The televisions were removed during inspection until they can be mounted.

Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: During the monitoring visit, there was a television sitting at a table. The director removed the television from the open classroom area to an area not used by children.

Safety - Televisions Anchored to Prevent Tip Over: During the monitoring visit, one of the classrooms had a television sitting on a shelf.
